notes: Terathan Keep is spider country: webs, egg sacs, cocoons and a larder. It has more lair dressing than any other dungeon, so every tier is webs; the Great Spider Web is the showpiece. These are lair dressing, not a species trophy; the giant-spider Nemesis trophy is a figurine.

entries.why: Spider egg sac the size of a loaf.
Cobwebbed sea chest nobody dares open.
Webbed egg clutch in fresh silk.
Spider's larder of cocoons round an egg sac.
Orb weaver's web across a doorway.
Great Spider Web, wall to wall, wide enough for an ogre.
